snippet.title: Robots At Midnight | Official Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Awaken on the ruined world of Yob, battle corrupted machines, and uncover the secrets of The Blackout in this retro-futuristic, action RPG. Available on Steam and Xbox on June 19, 2025.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623040/Robots_at_Midnight/
Pre-order on Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9nc17sx06dcn

Get ready to move fast, fight hard, and be home before midnight.
